prompt:
Create a horizontal group illustration of dwarves of the Grey Mountains for The One Ring culture artwork collection. Latest attached painted image is a SUBJECT, clothing and mood reference only. Translate it into the established warm brown PENCIL AND PEN drawing style of the recent horizontal culture groups; do not retain its golden painted color or photographic rendering.
THREE distinct adult dwarven travelers and ONE laden pack pony, all full figures comfortably within frame. Left a stern older hooded dwarf with thick divided beard and broad compact build, standing at three-quarter view with worn cloak, leather shoulder protection, belt pouches and stout walking staff. Center a mature hooded bearded dwarf looking left, practical layered leather and mail expedition clothes, one hand resting on the long wooden haft of a grounded forestry axe. Right a younger hooded dwarf with a shorter full beard, simple tunic, rolled blanket across shoulder and belt pouch, naturally holding the pony's loose lead rope. Pack pony stands between center and right figures slightly behind, small sturdy proportions, ears alert, loaded with balanced tied bundles and blanket rolls. Keep all three faces readable, dwarven short strong limbs, broad torsos and ordinary heavy boots; weatherworn modest gear, restrained geometric edging. Quiet wary travelers, no battle action.
Match recent horizontal redraws: fine expressive muted umber-brown contours, moderate selective directional hatching and small crosshatched dark pockets under hoods, inside beard locks, beneath cloth overlaps and pony packs. Broad light ivory paper highlights, hair in grouped locks, descriptive cloth folds and simple rope lines, no dense microtexture or smoothly blended realistic shading. Nearly white pale cream paper background, faint sketch hatch marks just behind group and small ground strokes beneath feet fading into blank. No forest or mountain landscape, no golden lighting wash, no full-color paint. Approximately 16:10 landscape composition, heads, pony ears, hooves, boots, staff and axe wholly inside generous pale margins, no close-up cropped foreground face. No lettering, frame or watermark. Three dwarves and one pony only.
